stages.label: Plinth and close
stages.description: A stone plinth with a cloister garden around the church and a paved forecourt at the entrance.

stages.label: Nave, aisles, transept, apse and towers
stages.description: Rasterise the hall: the nave as one tall reserved interior, aisles and transept as lower shells, towers with spires.

stages.label: Arcades, portal and processional route
stages.description: Cut the arcades between nave and aisles, the west portal and the doors from the towers and transept.

stages.label: Rule-driven growth
stages.description: Clerestory bays are glazed, columns crown and branch into the vault, buttress footings appear against the aisles.

stages.label: Constraint checks
stages.description: The nave must remain one open interior; every chapel and tower must be reachable from the portal.

stages.label: Architectural detailing
stages.description: Lights along the nave, hedges and trees in the close, lamps in the forecourt; the vault is glazed.
